authority: owner directive 'Juniper 1 engineering execution directive' (2026-10-13), section 6
purpose: seed replication of the v3 pilot recipe; changes only the seed and the run identity
lr_source: docs/posttrain/results/sft_pilot_v1/lr_selection.json (stage-1 rule of protocol v3; not re-selected per seed)
candidate: the final checkpoint of each run (update 1226); no other checkpoint is scored

steps: final checkpoint verify + exact dev-loss reproduction (pilot_recovery_check)
chat generations on all splits of bundle f9632015 (greedy)
compare with the preserved v1.2 base scores (j1data.sfteval compare)
evaluation.base_scores: preserved v1.2 base_scores.json (same bundle, same scorer, deterministic base generations)
evaluation.recovery_ab: the protocol-v3 stage-3 result (recovery_ab.json) for trainer package f13afbdf; valid for a replication only while its run reports the same package digest

decision.rule: protocol v3 decision rule applied per seed (tools/sft_decide.py)
decision.labels: PILOT_CANDIDATE_QUALIFIED / NOT_PROMOTED as in v3; a replication decision never promotes
decision.seed_1: the original pilot result and its scoring are kept unchanged and reported alongside

per_seed: every v3 category (strict) and slice, protocol validity, uncertainty, false abstention, full-split bpb, final dev loss
factuality per relation; held-out instruction families per family; Python slices
variance_report.summary: min, max, mean and sample standard deviation over the three seeds (n=3: descriptive only)
paired: each seed versus base few-shot on the same items (exact McNemar, as in v3)
each pair of seeds on the same items (exact McNemar per category; Holm over the 3 pairs within a category)
variance_report.item_vs_seed_uncertainty: item-level intervals (Wilson/bootstrap per seed) are reported separately from between-seed spread; pooled items are not treated as independent training replications

inconsistent_if_any: the three seeds do not all reach the same v3 decision
P1 (instruction following in distribution) differs between any two seeds with Holm-adjusted exact McNemar p < 0.05
consistency_check.consequence: diagnose the cause before seed 1's scores are used as a stable baseline for SFT v2 thresholds

corrected_rescoring.registered: after the successor scorer (finding S-09) is versioned in Juniper-1-Data
corrected_rescoring.inputs: the preserved raw generations of seeds 1, 2 and 3 (unchanged)
corrected_rescoring.label: CORRECTED_RESCORING_VIEW; never merged with original-scorer numbers in one comparison and not a replication of the unchanged evaluation

environment.planned: FLOWBOX RTX 2060, torch 2.8.0+cu128, fp32, TF32 off, deterministic algorithms, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 (same as seed 1)
environment.differences: recorded per run from the trainer's deps identity

budget.reason: local GPU reproduces the seed-1 environment exactly; ~1 h per seed measured on the pilot
